task.description:
Validate test design for AGT-05, AGT-06, AGT-07.

Check:
1. Every MUST AC covered by at least one test
2. No SkipZigTest on MUST tests
3. Fixtures isolated per test (per-test UUIDs, defer cleanup)
4. Self-contained tests
5. build.zig wires the test file
6. AGT-06 sweep tests: backdated timestamps used (not real 30/365 day waits)
7. AGT-07 deprecated check before schema validation confirmed

Return PASS or FAIL with specific gaps.

result.summary: Test design for AGT-05, AGT-06, AGT-07 validated. All 17 test cases (5+7+5) are fully implemented in tests/integration/test_agt05_07.zig with no gaps. Spec counts match test block counts. No SkipZigTest present. Fixtures use per-test random UUIDs via fillRandom, every test cleans up via defer. BPM_TEST_DB_URL absence fails with MissingTestDatabaseUrl (not silent skip). No HTTP server required — handlers called directly. All SQL uses parameterised queries. build.zig wires the file under step test-integration-agt05-07. AGT-06 time manipulation uses backdated SQL intervals (no real waits). AGT-07 TC-AGT07-04 confirms deprecated check fires before kind validation. AGT-07 is SHOULD priority (not MUST) and is fully covered anyway.
